generated.description: A large modern house built mostly from white quartz blocks and slabs, with gray and green terracotta accents, green wool and carpet, and blue stained glass panes. It sits on a grass and dirt terrace above a water feature, with an oak and spruce tree nearby. The build spans about 121 by 124 blocks and is 23 blocks high, with 72,139 blocks total; the source has no description, and interior contents are not documented beyond a few sign and skull block entities.
